correctness.rationale: The stationary density matrix follows from a convergent Poisson-age integral with gamma>0. The full-rank equatorial Bloch SLD line element gives det Q exactly by a nonsingular Jacobian. The positive denominator in the derivative isolates a cubic with exactly one positive zero by Descartes and endpoint signs. Explicit bracket evaluations and an implicit-derivative inequality prove all parameter bounds and strict normalized monotonicity. The packaged symbolic checker passed and its independent two-level SLD diagonalization was compared at 60 nondegenerate parameter triples plus 12 root cases. Finite checking is not the proof.

originality.rationale: The novel assessed claim is the global D-optimal Poisson-repreparation rate for jointly unknown Hamiltonian frequency and pure-dephasing strength, its unique cubic root, sharp normalized range and asymptotic information volume. The familiar equatorial QFIM, generic renewal state and weak-commutativity condition are not claimed new. Full primary texts for quantum reset renewal (2022), generic joint qubit phase-noise information (2014), and variational multiparameter sensing with dephasing (2023) were examined for this exact physical design optimization. Published nearest research-result summaries concern one-parameter discrete-time qubit phase estimation or reset-rate sensing rather than the present determinant optimization. Exact priority remains qualified.
residual_risks: Standard qubit QFIM plus quantum renewal readily yields the algebraic determinant; an unpublished or unindexed design optimization could have derived the same cubic.

value.rationale: Joint frequency and damping are natural coupled unknowns in qubit sensing; optimizing frequency-only QFI does not minimize joint error-area. The new exact information-volume formula, globally unique positive reset-rate optimum, sharp normalized window, strict detuning dependence, universal high-frequency limit and explicit collective-versus-single-shot distinction constitute a meaningful complete design classification. No downstream theorem, finite-sample protocol or experiment is claimed.
